record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Six units declare SPIKY_SHIELD: Silcoon, Cascoon, Chespin, Maractus (see appliesTo for stars), Quilladin and Chesnaught. The strategy is shared; unit differences are star count (table index), range and maxPP; none of the six declares a passive.
record.summary: The caster deals SPECIAL damage equal to round(multiplier x its own DEF) to the cast target (multiplier 0.6/0.8/1/2 by stars). If the caster already had spike armor when it cast, it also deals flat SPECIAL damage (30/30/30/60 by stars) to every enemy-team unit on the rays in all 8 directions out to the board edge. Afterwards it gains (or refreshes to the longer of old and new) spike armor for 3000/5000/10000/10000 ms. While spike armor is active, any unit that hits the caster from distance 1 (without PROTECTIVE_PADS) is wounded for 2000 ms and takes retaliation SPECIAL damage from the caster's DEF. On the production board (8 columns x 6 rows: BOARD_WIDTH 8, BOARD_HEIGHT 6, Board(rows, columns)), the RIGHT ray loops `x < board.rows` (6), so it stops at column 5 and never reaches columns 6 and 7 (a caster in column 4 reaches only column 5, from column 5 nothing); the other directions use the real bounds. The retaliation is not part of the strategy: it is the spike-armor block of PokemonEntity.onHit, which runs only after a successful basic attack (or the Loaded Dice second hit), not after every spell hit.

targeting.who: damage: the cast target (DEF-based) and, only if spike armor was already active at cast time, every enemy-team unit on the 8 rays from the caster; buff: the caster
targeting.note: The rays are unbounded in length (no maxRange) and not blocked by units. The cast target also receives ray damage if it lies on a ray, in addition to the DEF-based hit.

geometry.shape: single target + 8 straight rays (orthogonal and diagonal) from the caster's cell to the board edge, conditional on pre-existing spike armor

effects.scaling: base is the caster's current DEF, not a fixed number; then AP: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: then the target's SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce

effects.target: every enemy-team unit on the 8 rays, only if spike armor was already active at cast time
effects.scaling: AP: x (1 + AP/100); crit as above; each unit is hit once per ray that crosses it
effects.resolution: then SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers; per-target protect / skydiving / magicBounce block The rays use effectInOrientation with an Orientation (not an entity) as target, so there is no original-target fallback; RIGHT is shortened to column 5 on the 8 x 6 board.
cooldown = max(current, new); while active, melee-range hitters take retaliation damage (separate effect below)

effects.target: a unit that hits the spike-armored caster from distance 1 (no PROTECTIVE_PADS)
effects.scaling: round(caster DEF x factor x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if the retaliation rolled a crit)
effects.resolution: this is the spike-armor block of PokemonEntity.onHit (pokemon-entity.ts:1097-1126), executed for the HITTER (`this`) after a successful basic attack (PokemonState.attack calls onHit only when isAttackSuccessful, pokemon-state.ts:295-296) or the Loaded Dice second hit (items.ts:194); it is not triggered by spell damage (neither handleSpecialDamage nor handleDamage calls onHit). Conditions: the target (the spike-armored unit) has spikeArmor, the hitter is at Chebyshev distance exactly 1 and does not hold Protective Pads. Then the hitter is wounded for 2000 ms (triggerWound(2000, hitter, target); refused by Rune Protect, x1.3 under BLOODMOON, then the hitter's duration reductions) and takes SPECIAL handleDamage with attacker = the spike unit and isRetaliation true, damage round(DEF x factor x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if the roll succeeded) with factor 0.6 / 0.8 / 1 (1 for any other star count). Probe: DEF 50 gives 50 at 3 stars and 30 at 1 star.

statusEffects.effect: applied to the hitter in the retaliation block: refused by Rune Protect, duration x1.3 under BLOODMOON, then the hitter's duration reductions (status.ts:877-897); while wounded the unit's heals are blocked (handleHeal), with the Blood Moon / Blood Stone shield exception

starBehavior.note: all tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star column is not reachable by the bare factory star counts (the retaliation table has no 4th entry and uses 1 as fallback). Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Ray damage requires spike armor to be active at the moment of casting (a repeat cast within the duration). Ray length is the distance to the board edge; the RIGHT ray is bounded by board.rows (6) instead of board.columns (8) on the 8 x 6 production board, so it stops at column 5 (probe: caster (4,2) reaches (5,2) but never (7,2); from column 5 the ray visits nothing). Retaliation needs the attacker at distance exactly 1.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Two modes by pre-existing spikeArmor: first cast (no armor) = target hit + armor; a cast while armor is active = target hit + 8 rays + refreshed armor (the longer cooldown is kept). The animation flag also depends on the pre-cast state.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: target hit = DEF multiplier (0.6/0.8/1 for 1/2/3 stars) x the caster's DEF at cast time; ray hit 30 (1-3 stars); armor 3000/5000/10000 ms; retaliation DEF factor 0.6/0.8/1. Damage dealt = raw x (1 + AP/100) (x critPower on a crit), then SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleSpecialDamage's later modifiers (SPE_DEF division, shields, items, resurrection, field multipliers)
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located

The retaliation damage is requested through handleDamage with isRetaliation true; the final HP change depends on the generic damage pipeline (shields, items), which was not traced further; the wound status effect beyond triggerWound (blocked heals via handleHeal) was not traced
Board.orientation / getEntityOnCell were not read; the full per-direction loop bounds of effectInOrientation were read (board.ts:845-909) and probed
unresolved: Whether the DEF used for the target hit includes buffs applied earlier in the same fight (pokemon.def at cast time; no modifiers traced)
The RIGHT-ray shortfall is traced for the 8 x 6 board (probe) and is a property of the pinned helper as written, not patched here
The retaliation uses a 3-entry table only; for 4 stars it falls back to 1 (not reachable for listed units)
Whether the target is hit twice when it lies on a ray (code adds no exclusion)
Whether the six units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
